Name: PTM
Description: Service pistol, upgraded. Designed in the ’60s to equip police and army officers in Eastern Bloc countries. Popular in the Zone thanks to its reliability.

Name: UDP Compact
Description: A pistol known for its ergonomic design, accuracy, and reliability. Widely favored in the Zone, it is sought after by both professionals and affluent newcomers.

Name: APSB
Description: A silenced pistol, once a staple of the Soviet Special Forces. In the Zone, it quickly became a tool of choice for discreetly resolving all manner of problems.

Name: M10 Gordon
Description: Low price and low precision – that’s all you need to know about this submachine gun. Especially popular among rookies, but not for long. Real Zone life soon shows just how risky it is to cheap out on gear.

Name: Rhino
Description: With its high caliber, this revolver is often marketed as a hunting weapon, proving equally effective against African buffalo and Zone chimeras.

Name: Kora-1911
Description: Pistol with a capital “P”. A true classic of firearm engineering. Designed over a century ago, yet still relevant today thanks to its powerful ammunition and near-total reliability under any conditions.

Name: Viper-5
Description: A highly accurate and compact submachine gun favored by the rapid response units of various countries, as well as nearly every faction in the Zone.

Name: AKM-74U
Description: A shortened variant of the renowned assault rifle, this weapon combines the firepower of its larger counterpart with the compact frame of a submachine gun. It proves particularly valuable when venturing deep inside the Zone.

Name: Buket S-2
Description: Conceived by the USSR as a compact automatic self-defense weapon, this design has found popularity on the outskirts of the Zone despite its modest efficiency.

Name: Integral-A
Description: An elite submachine gun renowned for its effectiveness in confined spaces. A favorite among seasoned diggers.

Name: Zubr-19
Description: Based on the AKM-74U, the design of this submachine gun strikes a perfect balance between price, weight, accuracy, and rate of fire.

Name: Fora-230
Description: Modern Ukraine-produced submachine gun, developed for combat vehicle crews and police special ops units. Thanks to its size and rate of fire, it found its niche in the Zone as well.

Name: AKM-74S
Description: A modernized version of the iconic assault rifle. Exceptionally reliable in harsh conditions, it has become the weapon of choice for many factions in the Zone.

Name: AKM-74S
Description: A modernized version of the iconic assault rifle. Exceptionally reliable in harsh conditions, it has become the weapon of choice for many factions in the Zone.

Name: AKM-74S
Description: A modernized version of the iconic assault rifle. Exceptionally reliable in harsh conditions, it has become the weapon of choice for many factions in the Zone.

Name: AR416
Description: This assault rifle stands out as one of the most popular choices on the market. In the Zone, its true potential came to light during Freedom’s defense of the Barrier.

Name: GP37
Description: This German-made assault rifle is an exemplary piece of modern weaponry, featuring lightweight construction, excellent reliability, and an ergonomic design.

Name: Fora-221
Description: This modular next-gen assault rifle has earned multiple prestigious global accolades, along with unofficial commendations from the stalker community.

Name: Grom S-14
Description: Automatic rifle and grenade launcher system – an assault rifle configuration that can come in quite handy in the Zone. A good fit for lovers of ultimate firepower at both short and medium distances.

Name: VS Vintar
Description: This specialized rifle designed for suppressed fire is highly regarded among veterans for its ability to keep the shooter’s position concealed.

Name: Kharod
Description: A rare, advanced assault weapon system treasured by stalkers for its remarkable efficiency even in the most challenging conditions.

Name: AS Lavina
Description: Derived from the Vintar sniper rifle, this silenced assault rifle enables effective firing without exposing the shooter’s position.

Name: Dnipro
Description: Designed to replace the Soviet AKM-74 in special force units, this Ukrainian assault rifle is utilized not just by military special forces, but also by seasoned stalkers.

Name: ARev
Description: A game-changer in the world of guns. A modern assault rifle developed to potentially replace all platforms with intermediate and rifle calibers. Precise, reliable, comfortable. The only disadvantage is the price.

Name: RPM-74
Description: Combining the formidable firepower of a heavy machine gun with the portability of an assault rifle, this weapon excels at eliminating entire groups of enemies.

Name: Beast
Description: A machine gun modified under Korshunov's personal supervision. Weapon number 150289. It has an extended magazine and a high-precision laser designator, along with a custom-made grip and NATO collimator.

Name: Boomstick
Description: This small and lightweight sawed-off hunting shotgun proved itself surprisingly useful in the ever-changing environment of the Zone. Very efficient in close quarters and comfortable for concealed carry.

Name: TOZ-34
Description: A common hunting rifle, widespread and cheap. Still beats a handgun when it comes to dealing with mutants.

Name: M860 Cracker
Description: A pump-action shotgun prized for its lightweight build and reliability, it has earned a distinguished reputation as one of the world’s most famous shotguns and remains extremely popular in the Zone.

Name: SPSA-14
Description: A distinctive shotgun designed to accommodate various rounds, including police ammunition. Although weighty, it boasts excellent firepower.

Name: Saiga D-12
Description: Based on the AKM-74, this shotgun is favored among stalkers and professional military alike for its prowess as a powerful assault weapon.

Name: Ram-2
Description: Combining the strengths of pump-action shotguns and double-barreled rifles, this highly unusual weapon is an anomaly even by the Zone’s standards.

Name: Self-loading infantry carbine (SIC)
Description: The trend of regular infantry returning to the rifle carbine has finally reached the infantry carbine that was developed way back in World War II. A heavy-duty round and a modern stock allow this platform to be recognized as the same class as modern systems.

Name: Mark I EMR
Description: An American-made semi-automatic rifle introduced in the early 1950s, it has undergone several modernizations and upgrades over the years.

Name: GP3A
Description: Classic German Cold War era rifle. Thanks to its overall ergonomics, decent reliability, and sturdy ammunition, this weapon system is still widely used.

Name: SVDM-2
Description: This tried-and-true sniper rifle is a common sight in the Zone, delivering solid performance at a reasonable price.

Name: M701 Super
Description: Bolt-action sniper rifle. Considered a sport weapon on the Mainland, yet rather popular among mutant hunters and stalkers headed for Prypiat.

Name: SVU-MK S-3
Description: Sniper rifle designed for special forces. Some of the Zone’s wonders are better to watch from a safe distance. This beauty will help you to do just that.

Name: Three-Line Rifle
Description: This venerable three-line rifle spans both world wars and numerous other military conflicts. Legend has it its bullets can cut through rails — lengthwise.

Name: Gauss Gun
Description: Developed in the Zone and incorporating an electromagnetic bullet acceleration system, this sniper rifle is used exclusively within the Zone.

Name: RPG-7U
Description: A rocket-propelled grenade launcher dating back to the 1960s, found in abundance in military warehouses and subsequently making its way to the Zone. It operates as a smooth-bore, single-shot recoilless launcher.

Name: GP37V2
Description: A rare modification of the GP37, designed for the German Navy. Its key distinction from the base version is the replacement of its automatic fire with a three-round burst mode. It was released in a limited run and failed to find favor.

Name: Jagerblick
Description: ARev version with modifications to enhance marksmanship capabilities. An 8x sight, heavy stock for comfortable bracing, reinforced barrel with 1:8 twist for better stability, and a silencer – the perfect setup for a precision shooter.

Name: Honta's "Drahunka"
Description: This rifle served Honta for years, and now it has been passed on to his student. It's been well looked after and is still in good working order. Whether you're up against a rhino or a chimera, it won't fail you.

Name: Night Stalker
Description: A unique variant of the classic pistol. Custom-made components appear to have been precisely fitted during assembly. Chambered in 9mm Parabellum.

Name: Labyrinth IV
Description: “All the Zone really needs is our compassion.”

Name: Deadeye
Description: Crafted to order, this pistol is outfitted with sporting attachments. No one can ascertain how this rare piece found its way into the Zone, but the pistol still offers remarkable performance under harsh local conditions.

Name: Gambit
Description: The meaning of a sacrifice at the beginning of the game can only be truly appreciated in the endgame.

Name: PTM
Description: Developed in the 1960s, this modernized service pistol was introduced as the standard issue handgun for law enforcement and army officers in Eastern Bloc countries.

Name: Encourage
Description: Awarded to Alexander Korshunov during his time as a lieutenant, this pistol boasts precise craftsmanship. The bolt bears an inscription: “Glory. Service. Honor.”

Name: Gangster
Description: Modeled after gangster movies from the 80s and 90s, this customized M10 may look impressive, but its practicality in the Zone remains questionable.

Name: Shah’s Mate
Description: The personal firearm of the Shah, the kingpin of the Brood, is a custom order from the Mainland, complete with an extended magazine. You won’t find another gun quite like this in all of Garbage!

Name: Spitter
Description: While most stalkers aren’t big fans of the S-2, this one clearly belonged to a true aficionado. Engraved on the side are the letters “SC,” likely the former owner's initials.

Name: Special
Description: A special forces variant of an assault rifle, this particular piece was owned by a stalker known as Bes.

Name: Rat Killer
Description: A Zubr variant chambered for a different caliber. The body of this submachine gun boasts an urban camouflage paint job. It’s an absolute delight for shooting rats and rodents.

Name: Spitfire
Description: A compact self-defense weapon combining the rate of fire of a machine gun with the accuracy typically found in assault rifles.

Name: Combatant
Description: “Dmytro and I were just discussing a certain puzzle we’ve been working on in the Zone, but we can’t quite seem to get all the pieces to fit. Give me a hand, would you?”

Name: Drowned
Description: Somebody dropped this assault rifle in water. It can still do a decent job if you treat it right.

Name: Valik Lummox’s AKM-74S
Description: An old AKM-74S, must have fired thousands of rounds. Worn-out, but perfectly clean and greased. Looks like Valik Lummox never got the chance to see it in action.

Name: Decider
Description: An early version of the Fora-221, second-hand. The previous owner clearly splurged on upgrades.

Name: Merc
Description: A perfect tool is the first thought that comes to mind when examining this Vintar, tailored to excel in a specific range of tasks where silence is paramount.

Name: Sotnyk
Description: Degtyarev’s personal assault rifle is truly a universal soldier among weapons, equally effective against the most ferocious mutants and the most experienced enemy combatants.

Name: Clusterfuck
Description: An experiment to convert an assault rifle into sort of a sniper carbine — surprisingly successful despite the limitations of its ammunition.

Name: Unknown Stalker’s AR416
Description: An AR416 assault rifle found in the Poppy Field. It appears that the previous owner took excellent care of his weapon and seldom parted with it.

Name: Trophy
Description: An ordinary stalker acquired this special assault rifle in a battle with a certain veteran mercenary. It seems all that experience couldn’t spare the merc from an early grave.

Name: SOFMOD
Description: A rifle assembled by a certain Freedom member to suit his needs. An excellent choice if you want a single gun for tackling all the challenges the Zone throws your way.

Name: Grom S-15
Description: A factory-made Grom chambered in 5.45x39 caliber. While it may not have made waves on the Mainland for a number of reasons, in the Zone, it's acquired a devoted following, largely due to the wide range caliber it can accommodate.

Name: Predator
Description: Formerly belonging to Trapper, this custom-built pump-action shotgun was designed to meet the owner’s specific request for a significant boost in lethality.

Name: Sledgehammer
Description: A custom modification of an Italian shotgun, made for a famous stalker. This firearm combines high damage with a surprisingly decent rate of fire for a shotgun.

Name: Texan
Description: A true embodiment of Texan gun culture, this weapon is heavy, expensive, powerful, and absolutely merciless.

Name: Glutton
Description: A fusion of light machine gun and tank machine gun, this hybrid features a larger ammo box, a heavy barrel, and a lightweight bolt. The cost of improved reliability, extended range, and increased rate of fire is the substantial uptick in overall weight.

Name: Lynx
Description: This rifle boasts a unique modification, handcrafted by a now-deceased master. The addition of a new barrel with a custom twist rate has notably improved accuracy and damage, though it appears to have seen little use of late.

Name: Partner
Description: This well-worn Mark rifle is fitted with a collimator sight, indicating the owner’s desire to gain an edge in firefights at short and medium range.

Name: Whip
Description: This rifle has replaced the Lynx in the hands of the finest Monolith sniper. It’s rare to find a rifle that excels in both rate of fire and accuracy, but this one defies the norm.

Name: Cavalier
Description: The owner must have watched too many documentaries on early 20th-century military conflicts, leading to a desire to own a modern reinterpretation of a bolt-action cavalry carbine.

Name: Skif’s Pistol
Description: Skif’s honorary PTM. A somewhat painful reminder of the army that became a comfortable, familiar weapon.

Name: SVU-MK S-3
Description: Sniper rifle designed for special forces. Some of the Zone’s wonders are better to watch from a safe distance. This beauty will help you to do just that.

Name: EM-1
Description: A unique modification of the gauss cannon. It was designed specifically to disable electrical appliances, but it can also harm living creatures by affecting the target's nervous system.

Name: Reyka
Description: This shotgun features a rifled barrel, enhancing its performance with slugs, but precluding the use of buckshot. The end result is akin to a handmade elephant gun, crafted with the purpose of hunting pseudogiants.

Name: TOZ-34
Description: A common hunting rifle, widespread and cheap. Still beats a handgun when it comes to dealing with mutants.

Name: Veteran
Description: I'll make it, whatever it takes. I'll buy my own house... near the river, at the forest edge. No more radiation, no more beasts, no more freaking bastards.

Name: M860 Monolith
Description: ... Blessed be their eternal union with the Monolith! Death, cruel death to those who reject Its sacred power!

Name: AR416 Monolith
Description: ... To battle, defenders of the Monolith! Fight! Avenge our fallen brothers...

Name: PTM Monolith
Description: Thank you for revealing the cunning plans of Your enemies to us! May Your light shine down on the souls of the brave soldiers who gave their lives in service to Your will. Blessed be their eternal union with the Monolith!

Name: Riemann
Description: An Integral-A after some serious tuning. The main difference from the basic version is a specialized barrel with an integrated sound moderator and a longer handguard.

Name: "Hunter"
Description: A rifle, modified specifically for better camouflage. Great for counter-sniping, especially in a forest.

Name: SA-U "Gabion"
Description: A short-barrel prototype of a special-ops rifle. Developed for concealed carry and extremely close-quarter battle.

Name: Model Competitor
Description: A manual-assembly sport revolver. All the gaps adjusted, trigger mechanism replaced with a sharper one. Great choice for shooting bloodsuckers…speed shooting bloodsuckers.

Name: Viper "Monolith"
Description: "For it is your will, Monolith, that makes us strong. You have guided us. You have let us see and know. Why have you gone silent?.."

Name: Lullaby
Description: A Fora-221, with numerous modifications to achieve increased efficiency for special missions inside and outside the Zone. Equipped with a built-in sound moderator.

Name: "Margach D-12MT"
Description: A customized version of the D-12 smooth-bore shotgun. Aluminum and polymer components reduce weight, improving the overall ergonomics.

Name: Warszawa
Description: ARev, modified for the standard round of the former Warsaw Bloc. Offered for export to Eastern countries to replace the outdated AKM-74 series and its contemporaries. As it's a new product, it hasn't become very popular yet.

Name: Leichtfuchs
Description: A lightweight assault version of the ARev, custom-tailored by a master gunsmith. The owner was clearly ready to invest as much as needed to get everything at once – light weight, reliability, firepower, and multi-purposeness.

Name: Justice
Description: "That Captain Tachenko died a long time ago… and this General Tachenko of Duty will follow him… That's justice, I suppose…"

Name: Clapper
Description: A Customized version of the M860 shotgun. The installed silencer and laser sight indicate that the owner wanted to turn the good old shotgun into a real tactical weapon.

Name: Guardian
Description: "…it doesn't matter who you are, it matters what cause you serve.”

Name: AKM-9B
Description: Small-batch AKM-74 variation for 9x39 caliber. This version is a cheap but effective alternative to a Lavina or a Vintar.

Name: Luftgarde
Description: A shorter assault version of the GP3, modified by a local armorer. Rifle rounds inside a lightweight carbine – a deadly combo.

Name: Mriya
Description: "Remember… how we wanted to change the world?"

Name: Maximum
Description: SVU-MK, modified for extremely short-range combat. The word is that this rifle belonged to a seasoned Freedom fighter.

Name: Rifled barrel
Description: Modified to decrease dispersion, this SPSA-14 isn't suitable for shotgun ammunition, but it's perfect for slugs or darts. Good enough for an improvised sniper rifle.

Name: Freedom's Bounty
Description: A custom-built rifle. The parts have been treated with an anti-corrosion coating and meticulously fitted. The receiver is covered in an unusual but masterfully painted ornament. It’s unlikely there is a second weapon like it in the Zone.

Name: Stranger's Rifle
Description: Found at the site of a skirmish between an unknown Duty fighter and a pair of chimeras. Both beasts were slain, but the hero’s body could not be identified due to the severity of his wounds. The weapon has not had a new owner since.
